searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: HTTP Request node pagination nextURL expression $response.body._links.next reference another node .first() instead of .item paired item

labeler1:309257.key_step: In the pagination Next URL expression, reference the base-URL node with $('Set API base URL').first() instead of .item, because .item throws 'Missing sourceData' in the pagination context. Also keep a guard that falls back to base URL + the initial versions path when $response.body._links.next is absent.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: DeepSeek Chat Model reasoning_content must be passed back to the API thinking mode AI Agent

labeler1:298570.key_step: Use a workaround, because n8n's built-in DeepSeek Chat Model node doesn't pass reasoning_content back to the API in thinking mode. This is a known bug on the n8n backlog. The accepted answer's workaround is to install the community node n8n-nodes-deepseek-v4 (self-hosted only) and turn off Thinking Mode.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: focus column button table view node input output missing

labeler1:271805.key_step: Report the missing column-focus button in Table view (n8n@2.9.3) as a possible regression on the n8n GitHub repo, using JSON view with Ctrl+F as a temporary workaround.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: n8n publish:workflow CLI command restart required changes take effect while n8n is running

labeler1:266219.key_step: Treat the CLI 'restart n8n' warning as not applying: the accepted answer says that in a database-backed, main-mode setup the published version is picked up on the next execution without a restart.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: migrate from Zapier to n8n rebuild Zaps as workflows

labeler1:307984.key_step: Manually rebuild each Zap as an n8n workflow (trigger, conditions, actions), migrating a few simple Zaps first and running Zapier in parallel to compare results, since there is no automatic Zapier import.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Chat Hub introduced in n8n version 2.1.0 release notes upgrade

labeler1:271048.key_step: Upgrade the self-hosted instance from v2.0.3 to at least v2.1.0, because the accepted answer says Chat Hub isn't available in earlier versions, and the Chat icon then appears without any env vars.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: copy nodes workflow JSON share, Help > About version, view error details in node output

labeler1:310250.key_step: Ask posters to select the failing nodes on the canvas, copy them with Ctrl+C (credentials are stripped) and paste the workflow JSON in a code block instead of a screenshot. The accepted answer also asks for the version and setup from Help > About and the full error text from the node's JSON Details.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: n8n node get a workflow by ID returns description; get many workflows response fields public API

labeler1:309760.key_step: Use the n8n node's 'Get Many' to list the tagged workflows, then pass each workflow ID to a second n8n node set to 'Get' and read {{ $json.description }}, because the list endpoint omits description while GET /workflows/{id} returns it.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Switch node Always Output Data empty output goes to first output instead of the empty branch

labeler1:274129.key_step: Turn off Always Output Data on the Switch node, because it wrongly routes the empty item through the first output (GitHub issue #17504). Then handle empty branches separately, for example with a No Operation node after each output.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: HTTP Request node batching items per batch send requests in parallel

labeler1:306794.key_step: Emit the three LLM requests as separate items from a Code node and send them through one HTTP Request node with Options → Batching → Items per Batch set to 3, so the requests in the batch run concurrently instead of branch by branch.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: LDAP node Update operation attributes omit attribute skip empty value delete attribute

labeler1:287340.key_step: Do not pass undefined/null to the LDAP Update node's department attribute; branch the logic before the node (IF/Switch) so department is sent only as a real string when replacing, and omitted when skipping.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: run @n8n/scan-community-package@beta to fix cred-filename-against-convention error on compiled dist credentials file

labeler1:304343.key_step: Run the scanner from the beta dist-tag (npx @n8n/scan-community-package@beta @ambriel-io/n8n-nodes-ambriel), because the tagged release of the scanner had a bug in the cred-filename-against-convention check on compiled dist files and the beta carries the fixed lints.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: n8n Cloud maximum workflow execution timeout per plan

labeler1:276736.key_step: Understand that the old 5-minute Starter execution limit no longer applies on n8n Cloud, which depends on current Cloud timeout behavior that the docs don't state in numbers.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Execute Command node Windows cmd powershell window visible after update regression downgrade n8n version

labeler1:302503.key_step: Roll back to the previously installed n8n version with npm install -g n8n@<previous-version> and restart n8n, since 2.29.7 introduced a regression that makes the Windows Execute Command shell window visible.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Zendesk Trigger node missing credentials publish workflow 400 bad request

labeler1:270419.key_step: Re-attach a valid Zendesk API credential to the Zendesk Trigger node, whose credentials object was empty, so that publishing can register the webhook with Zendesk using real authentication instead of returning 400 Bad Request.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Connect Browser Use extension AI Assistant self-hosted custom domain isn't a valid n8n instance allowlist localhost

labeler1:309050.key_step: Open the n8n editor via localhost (for example through an SSH tunnel to 127.0.0.1:5678) so the relay URL hostname passes the Connect Browser Use extension's hardcoded hostname allowlist, then start the connect from the Assistant's Connections panel.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Edit Fields (Set) node assignment field type Array instead of String JSON.parse expression

labeler1:273323.key_step: In the Edit Fields (Set) node, change the 'data' field's type from String to Array so the JSON.parse result is kept as a real array instead of being coerced to '[object Object]', and remove the stray leading '=' before the expression.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: change n8n Cloud version Updates & maintenance release track Stable; fix No bridge acquired for this context expression engine

labeler1:306956.key_step: Move the Cloud workspace off 1.123.69 to a newer version, using Manage > Workspace > Updates & maintenance > n8n version > Change version, because the 'No bridge acquired' error is an n8n-internal bug and not a credential problem.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: dummy.stack.replace is not a function Google Sheets error fixed in n8n version upgrade

labeler1:286540.key_step: Upgrade n8n beyond 2.15.0 (accepted answer says 2.17+) to pick up a reported fix for an error-handling bug that causes 'dummy.stack.replace is not a function'.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Code node typeVersion 2 language python pythonNative workflow JSON API

labeler1:275504.key_step: Set the Code node's typeVersion to 2 in the workflow JSON sent through the API, because typeVersion 1 of the node doesn't support the Python language option and shows both editors.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: AI Agent memory node Key parameter session ID expression without Chat Trigger, define below, webhook

labeler1:297496.key_step: Extract the Instagram sender ID into a sessionId field in a Set node before the AI Agent, then set the memory node's Key (Session ID: Define below) to {{ $json.sessionId }} so it still resolves when the agent calls tools.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: source control environments credentials sync non-sensitive credential fields Mailjet sandbox mode overwritten on pull

labeler1:273951.key_step: Treat the synced Mailjet Sandbox Mode value as an n8n bug and file it on GitHub. Until it is fixed, keep sandbox vs live out of the synced credential, for example with separate credentials per environment.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: HTTP Request node REPORT method body not sent WebDAV CalDAV custom method

labeler1:268997.key_step: Skip the HTTP Request node, which the answerer says drops the body for the REPORT method, and send the REPORT request with the XML body, Depth header and Authorization header from a Code node using fetch.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: AI Agent node continue when tool fails or returns no result instead of stopping workflow

labeler1:297687.key_step: Change the AI Agent node's typeVersion from 3.1 to 2.2 in the node JSON, a workaround for a reported v3.1 bug where a failing or empty tool result stops the agent.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: n8n sign up personal email instead of company email allowed

labeler1:292397.key_step: Sign up with a personal email address, since n8n's sign-up does not restrict registration to company emails (only some external services may require a corporate email).

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Send Email node attachments binary property names input item must contain binary data; binary data lost after intermediate node

labeler1:309749.key_step: Re-attach the IMAP trigger's binary to the item right before Send email, for example with a Code node that returns json plus binary from the trigger. Then set the Attachments option to the binary property names on that item, e.g. {{ Object.keys($binary).join(',') }}.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: automate owner setup and create API key without UI n8n docker compose postgres

labeler1:294401.key_step: Start n8n with a fixed N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY, call the internal POST /rest/owner/setup endpoint once to create the owner, then call POST /rest/me/api-keys to mint an API key, and snapshot and reuse the Postgres volume across CI runs.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: creator page goes live after workflow templates approved n8n creator profile

labeler1:274571.key_step: Submit workflow templates to the n8n template library and get them approved (reportedly around 3), after which the creator page goes live automatically.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Shopify Trigger webhook conflict when activating multiple workflows; add new trigger node instead of copy-paste

labeler1:299450.key_step: Delete the copy-pasted Shopify Trigger node and add a freshly created one in each workflow, one per topic (create, update, delete), so each trigger gets its own webhook path and the publish conflict clears.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Webhook node Respond parameter Using 'Respond to Webhook' node Immediately When Last Node Finishes

labeler1:264833.key_step: The error is an n8n bug in checkResponseModeConfiguration (test-mode webhook, per GitHub #13836/#13086, which is still open). The workable steps are to set the Webhook node's Respond to a mode that matches the workflow (Immediately, When Last Node Finishes, or a properly connected Respond to Webhook node) or to use the production URL instead of the test URL.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: n8n 2.9.0 release notes fix MCP toggle in workflow settings not persisting

labeler1:268806.key_step: Upgrade n8n from 2.8.3 to 2.9.0 or later, which includes the editor fix for the workflow-settings MCP toggle not persisting (PR #25630).

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Outlook node send one email with multiple attachments from multiple items merge binary data

labeler1:255738.key_step: Rename each item's binary property to a unique name (e.g. data1, data2) with an Edit Fields (Set) node, merge the items into one, then list each binary property name as a separate attachment in a single Outlook node so only one email is sent.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Gmail trigger disable download attachments, process attachments one at a time with Loop Over Items batch size 1 to reduce memory usage

labeler1:296744.key_step: Turn off the Gmail trigger's downloadAttachments option so it returns only metadata, then fetch each PDF with a Gmail 'Get a Message Attachment' node inside a Loop Over Items (SplitInBatches) loop with batch size 1.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: n8n public API update workflow PUT description field

labeler1:298502.key_step: Send a PUT request to /api/v1/workflows/{id} with a top-level 'description' field (not inside meta) alongside name, nodes, connections and a cleaned settings object containing only accepted fields such as executionOrder (omitting binaryMode).

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Discord node webhook Invalid URL error sendLegacy workaround HTTP Request node POST to Discord webhook URL

labeler1:307158.key_step: Work around the Discord node's webhook-send bug (logged as NODE-5739) by using an HTTP Request node to POST to the Discord webhook URL until n8n ships a fix.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: node with two input connections runs twice; remove duplicate connection to HTTP Request node

labeler1:254722.key_step: Delete the extra incoming connection (likely the direct one from the AI node) to the HTTP Request node, so the node runs once with the input that includes media[0].source_url.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Facebook Lead Ads Trigger multiple forms same app credentials webhook

labeler1:254693.key_step: Per the accepted answer, use one Facebook Lead Ads Trigger node per form, with both nodes on credentials from the same Facebook app.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: HTTP Request pagination expression paired item sourceData first

labeler2:309257.key_step: Use `.first()` instead of paired item referencing (`.item`) when reading previous node data within HTTP Request pagination expressions, along with guarding for the initial call before `$response` is populated.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: DeepSeek reasoning_content thinking mode

labeler2:298570.key_step: Work around the DeepSeek reasoning_content issue by installing the community node n8n-nodes-deepseek-v4 and disabling thinking mode.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: table view focus column button missing UI

labeler2:271805.key_step: Report the missing table view column focus button as a UI regression on GitHub, using JSON view as a temporary workaround.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: n8n publish workflow restart changes will not take effect

labeler2:266219.key_step: Safely ignore the warning to restart n8n, as workflow updates published via CLI take effect immediately in database-backed setups.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: migrate workflows from Zapier rebuild

labeler2:307984.key_step: Manually recreate the workflow logic in n8n by mapping triggers and actions from Zapier and reconnecting credentials, as n8n does not have an automated importer for Zapier workflows.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: chat hub release notes 2.1.0

labeler2:271048.key_step: Upgrade n8n to version 2.1.0 or later because Chat Hub was not introduced until v2.1.0.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: share workflow json copy nodes error details forum

labeler2:310250.key_step: When asking for technical help on the forum, provide the workflow JSON copied directly from the canvas into code blocks, the instance version and deployment setup from Help > About, and the full error details found by switching the failing node's output panel to JSON.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: n8n api workflows get description

labeler2:309760.key_step: Use the n8n node's 'Get' operation (or GET /workflows/{id}) with each workflow ID to retrieve the workflow description, as 'Get Many' returns a trimmed object omitting it.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Switch node Always Output Data first output empty

labeler2:274129.key_step: Disable 'Always Output Data' on the Switch node to avoid the bug where empty data is incorrectly routed to the first output.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: HTTP Request node batching execute items in parallel

labeler2:306794.key_step: Restructure the workflow to pass each model request as an individual item into a single HTTP Request node configured with batching to send requests concurrently.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: LDAP node argument must be a string undefined null

labeler2:287340.key_step: Omit the attribute from the LDAP node configuration or branch workflow execution beforehand rather than passing an expression that evaluates to undefined or null.

labeler2:304343.key_step: Run the beta version of the scanner using `npx @n8n/scan-community-package@beta` to bypass a bug in the tagged release.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: n8n Cloud workflow execution timeout limit

labeler2:276736.key_step: Recognize that n8n Cloud no longer enforces a strict short execution timeout per workflow.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Execute Command windows cmd powershell visible regression downgrade

labeler2:302503.key_step: Downgrade n8n to a previous version using npm until the regression causing visible shell windows on Windows is patched.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: zendesk trigger credentials publish activate error

labeler2:270419.key_step: Select or re-assign valid Zendesk credentials in the Zendesk Trigger node.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: "isn't a valid n8n instance" browser extension localhost tunnel

labeler2:309050.key_step: Access the n8n editor via localhost using an SSH port-forwarding tunnel so the browser extension's allowlist check succeeds.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: expression leading equals sign object array string

labeler2:273323.key_step: Remove the leading '=' before the double curly brackets '{{' in the expression and change the Edit Fields parameter type to Array.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: No bridge acquired for this context Call acquire first

labeler2:306956.key_step: Upgrade n8n Cloud to a newer version via Manage > Workspace > Updates & maintenance to resolve the internal bridge acquisition bug.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: dummy.stack.replace is not a function

labeler2:286540.key_step: Upgrade n8n to version 2.17 or later where the internal error serialization bug has been patched.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Code node typeVersion python

labeler2:275504.key_step: Set the Code node's `typeVersion` property to 2 (or higher) in the workflow JSON definition.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: AI Agent memory tool execution Key parameter empty sessionId

labeler2:297496.key_step: Extract the session ID into a Set node directly before the AI Agent and reference it in the Memory node's Key parameter using {{$json.sessionId}}.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: environments credential sync sandbox mode non-sensitive properties

labeler2:273951.key_step: Report the issue as a bug on GitHub, and work around it by using an HTTP Request node configured with an environment variable for the Mailjet API endpoint instead of the Mailjet credential sandbox toggle.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: HTTP Request node custom method body REPORT

labeler2:268997.key_step: Use a Code node with fetch to send the REPORT request with a body because the HTTP Request node does not send request bodies for custom methods like REPORT.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: AI Agent tool fail stop workflow typeVersion

labeler2:297687.key_step: Downgrade the AI Agent node to typeVersion 2.2 by editing the node's JSON in a text editor and pasting it back into n8n.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: sign up company email personal email account registration

labeler2:292397.key_step: Sign up using a personal email address, as n8n does not restrict registration to corporate domains.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Send email node attachments binary properties input item

labeler2:309749.key_step: Restore the binary data onto the item entering the Send Email node using a Code node, and specify its binary property names in the Attachments option.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY /rest/owner/setup api keys automated setup

labeler2:294401.key_step: Use a fixed N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY, create the owner and an API key via the internal /rest/owner/setup and /rest/me/api-keys endpoints, and snapshot the database volume for reuse across CI test runs.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: n8n creator page publish approved workflows

labeler2:274571.key_step: Submit and have workflows approved for publication so the creator profile page is activated and publicly accessible.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: webhook path conflict copy trigger node unique path

labeler2:299450.key_step: Delete the copied trigger node and add a fresh one from scratch to generate a unique webhook path and resolve the conflict.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: checkResponseModeConfiguration getChildNodes Webhook 'Respond to Webhook'

labeler2:264833.key_step: Change the Webhook node's 'Respond' setting to 'Immediately' or 'When Last Node Finishes' (or reimport the workflow to remove stale node references) to bypass the test-mode validation bug.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: release notes 2.9.0 mcp toggle workflow settings

labeler2:268806.key_step: Upgrade n8n to version 2.9.0 or later, which resolves the bug preventing MCP settings from persisting in the UI.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: microsoft outlook send multiple binary attachments

labeler2:255738.key_step: Rename each binary property to a unique name and merge the files into a single item, then add each property as an attachment in the Outlook node.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Gmail trigger downloadAttachments memory limit get attachment

labeler2:296744.key_step: Disable downloading attachments in the Gmail trigger and instead fetch attachments sequentially in a loop to minimize memory usage.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: n8n API update workflow description PUT /api/v1/workflows

labeler2:298502.key_step: Pass the description property at the root level of the request payload when sending a PUT request to the /api/v1/workflows/{id} endpoint.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Discord node Invalid URL parseDiscordError sendLegacy

labeler2:307158.key_step: Use an HTTP Request node to send a POST request directly to the Discord webhook URL as a temporary workaround for an acknowledged bug in the Discord node's webhook execution path (NODE-5739).

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: node multiple inputs runs twice remove connection HTTP Request

labeler2:254722.key_step: Disconnect the unnecessary incoming connection to the HTTP Request node so it only executes once with the correct input data.

searches.name: S2
searches.what: the key fix alone: Facebook Lead Ads Trigger multiple forms credentials app

labeler2:254693.key_step: Configure both Facebook Lead Ads Trigger nodes in the workflow using credentials from the same Facebook app rather than separate apps.
